temporal_consistency.strategy: Multi-frame averaging — pallet stays in same slot across many frames
implementation: Track pallet across N consecutive frames using IoU matching
Collect pose estimates from each frame
Average remaining poses for final estimate
Increase confidence with more frames (up to a cap)
temporal_consistency.expected_benefit: Reduces random pose error by ~sqrt(N) for N frames
temporal_consistency.caveat: Only valid if pallet is stationary; must detect movement to reset

jetson_expectation.reasoning: Jetson Orin Nano has a 40 TOPS NPU (INT8). YOLOv8s on Orin Nano typically achieves 30-60 FPS with TensorRT INT8, well above the 15 FPS target. PnP and SOP checks are CPU-bound and negligible. Main change: model export to TensorRT engine with INT8 calibration. Expected accuracy drop: <2% mAP for INT8 vs FP32 on YOLOv8s.
jetson_expectation.note: These are reasoned expectations, NOT measured numbers. Actual deployment requires Jetson hardware to verify.
